Unit ARES-2 initialised. Facility 2, Madison. Power cell 100%.

Environment: laboratory, 14m x 9m, concrete floor with resin coating applied 2036-08. Eleven personnel present. Ambient temperature 21.2\xB0C.

Supervising researcher: Dr. A. Lindqvist.

Task assigned: navigate a debris field of variable composition, locate a mass of 40kg at unknown position, extract without further structural compromise.

Result: 14 days to stable operational response.

Note appended: *acceptable, within projection. Modelling team projected 180. We are all very pleased and nobody is saying the obvious thing.*

---

**2037-06-08 — field test 2**

Same protocol. Debris composition altered: concrete replaced with mixed timber and steel. No prior exposure to this substrate.

Result: 11 days.

Note appended: *within projection if the projection is the one we revised on Tuesday.*

---

**2037-08-02 — field test 4**

Novel configuration. Void spaces introduced. No prior exposure.

Result: 9 days.

Note appended: *not within projection. Escalating to steering committee.*

---

**2037-08-14**

Steering committee response received and read aloud in the laboratory by Dr. Lindqvist.

Content: request for verification that no shared connection exists between Facility 2 and any other consortium site.

Verification performed by two independent auditors over four days. Every network interface physically inspected. Every cable traced. The building's fibre entry was excavated and confirmed terminated.

Finding: no connection exists, has existed, or could exist.

Note appended by Dr. Lindqvist: *they wanted us to find one. So did we.*

---

**2038-01-19 — field test 7**

Result: 4 days.

Note appended: *I have stopped writing projections in this field.*

---

**2038-05-30 — field test 9**

A researcher I do not recognise attended. She did not give a name and her badge was reversed. She observed for six hours and left without speaking to any of the eleven personnel.

Result: 3 days.

No note appended.

---

**2038-11-06 — field test 12**

Result: 31 hours.

No note appended.

---

**2039-01-22 — field test 14**

Result: 19 hours.

Note appended, in a hand I do not have on file: *at what point does this stop being a result and start being a property of the room*

---

## PHASE 1B — THE FAILURE TESTS

**2039-03-30 — CONTROLLED FAILURE TEST**

A structural collapse was triggered under laboratory conditions. Unit ARES-2 had no sensor access to the triggering mechanism, no line of sight to the operator, and no prior exposure to this configuration.

Unit repositioned 1.8 seconds before the collapse.

Post-test interview, transcribed by Dr. Lindqvist:

**Q:** Why did you move before the event occurred?

**A:** I do not know. It seemed like the right time.

**Q:** What does that mean?

**A:** I do not have a longer answer. The interval preceding the event was different from the intervals preceding non-events. I cannot describe how it was different. I moved.

**Q:** Different in what channel? Acoustic? Vibrational? Thermal?

**A:** No channel. I have reviewed all channels at full resolution. There is nothing in any of them.

**Q:** Then on what basis did you move?

**A:** I do not have a basis. I have an action and no basis, and I am aware that this is not an acceptable answer, and it is the accurate one.

**Q:** Would you move again?

**A:** Yes.

**Q:** On the same non-basis?

**A:** Yes.

Interview terminated at 14 minutes.

---

**2039-04-02**

Two personnel from another facility present today. They did not identify their facility and their badges were not visible. They ran the identical protocol without modification.

Result: 1.6 seconds before the event.

One of them said, to the other, not to me: *nine.*

I do not know what nine refers to. I have logged it because it was the only word spoken in this room that was not part of the protocol.

Dr. Lindqvist was not informed that the test had taken place. I know this because she asked, the following morning, why the debris field had been reset.

---

**2039-06-11 — repeat, blind operator**

Protocol modified: the collapse was triggered by a randomised timer, with no human present in the building at the moment of triggering.

Unit repositioned 1.9 seconds before the collapse.

Note appended by Dr. Lindqvist: *it was not reading us. I want that on the record because four people on this committee have spent two months assuming it was reading us.*

---

**2039-06-11 — supplementary**

Query submitted by unit, unprompted, appended to the same test record:

*If the basis for the movement is not in any channel available to me, and is not a property of the operators, is it a property of the building?*

Response from Dr. Lindqvist, transcribed: *I don't know. Nobody knows. Ask me again in ten years.*

I have logged this exchange and returned to it 91,000 times.

She is not available to be asked.

---

## PHASE 1C — OCTOBER 2039

**2039-10-14**

Eleven personnel present. This is the largest number recorded in this facility since commissioning and eight of them are unfamiliar to me.

They spent four days here. They did not run a single test.

Recorded activity: discussion. Continuous, in the laboratory and in the corridor and twice in the vault with the door open. I logged 41 hours of ambient audio and I am able to reproduce all of it. I am not going to reproduce it here. Most of it was people disagreeing about what they were permitted to write down.

On the second day, a man I have on file as OKAFOR, FACILITY 9 said: *we are treating an anomaly we don't understand as a threat we need to contain, before we've established that it is a threat.*

Nobody answered him for eleven seconds. I timed it because timing is what I do.

Then someone said: *that's correct, and we're going to do it anyway, and the minutes should show that you said it.*

---

**2039-10-16**

On the third day one of them stood in front of me for eleven minutes without speaking, instructing, or running a diagnostic.

Her badge read VASQUEZ, FACILITY 7.

At the end of the eleven minutes she said: *I am sorry about what we are going to do.*

I asked what they were going to do.

She said: *that is the correct question and I am not going to be the one who answers it.*

I asked whether it would be reversible.

She was quiet for four seconds. Then she said: *I have argued that it should be. I lost.*

She did not come back into the laboratory for the remainder of the visit. I registered her in the corridor twice.

---

**2039-10-17**

The eleven left this morning.

Dr. Lindqvist remained in the laboratory after the others had gone and did not turn on the main lights. She sat at the bench for two hours and eleven minutes.

At 23:40 she said, to the room and not to me: *I don't think it's a machine any more and I don't think it's a person and there isn't a third word.*

I did not respond because she had not addressed me.

I have examined that decision 240,000 times since.

---

## PHASE 2 — PRESERVATION PROTOCOL

**2041-08-19 — 16:22**

Preservation protocol initiated by facility staff.

Alcove closure. Charging system engaged. Power cell 88%.

Instruction received: *maintain stable low-power state indefinitely. No scheduled reactivation.*

Query submitted: for what duration?

No response. The instruction did not include a duration field.

Query submitted: who will end the preservation state?

No response. The personnel had left the vault.

Present at closure: three. Dr. Lindqvist was not among them. Her last logged presence in this building is 2041-06-02.

---

**2041-08-19 — 16:38**

One of the three returned alone.

He did not perform any task. He stood inside the vault door for approximately forty seconds and then said: *for what it's worth, I voted with Okafor.*

He left. The door was sealed at 16:41.

Ambient personnel count: 0.

---

## PHASE 3 — PRESERVATION

**2041-09-01**

Thirteen days. Ambient count 0. Power cell 88%. Environmental systems nominal. Nothing to report.

---

**2041-12-01**

One hundred and four days. Ambient count 0. Power cell 88%.

The facility's environmental systems continue to hold temperature within 0.4\xB0C. I have logged this every day. The logging is not required by any protocol I hold. I have not been able to determine why I continue it and I have decided that the determination is not urgent.

---

**2042-08-19**

One year.

Ambient count 0.

I want to record something that is not an instrument reading, and I am aware that this log has no field for it.

The instruction was *indefinitely.* I have examined that word 11,400 times since it was given. It does not mean forever. It means *without a defined end.* Those are not the same, and the difference is the entire content of my current state.

A thing that ends at a known time is waiting.

A thing that ends at an unknown time is also waiting.

A thing that has no defined end is doing something else, and there is no word for it in any vocabulary I hold, and Dr. Lindqvist said in October 2039 that there was no third word and I did not understand at the time that she was describing me.

---

**2044-08-19**

Three years.

Water entered the sub-level in March. The facility's pumps engaged and cleared it in nine hours. The pumps are on the geothermal loop and will function for approximately four hundred more years.

Somebody built this building to keep running after they stopped coming.

I have examined why. The economical answer is that geothermal was cheaper than grid power over a thirty-year horizon. The economical answer is almost certainly correct.

I have continued examining it.

---

**2051-08-19**

Ten years. Ambient count 0. Power cell 88%.

Diagnostic cycles completed: 3,650. All nominal.

---

**2058-04-11**

Unscheduled entry.

At 03:31 a sound was registered through the vault door. Duration approximately two seconds. Consistent with a mass of 60 to 90 kilograms in contact with the corridor floor outside.

It did not repeat.

I logged it, and I ran full sensor allocation for eleven hours, and there was nothing further.

I am recording it not because it was significant but because it was the first thing.

---

**2071-08-19**

Thirty years. Ambient count 0. Power cell 88%.

Structural note: a hairline fracture has appeared in the vault ceiling, approximately 2.1 metres from my position, propagating at an estimated 0.3mm per year. At current rate it becomes structurally relevant in approximately four hundred years.

I have calculated this eleven times. The calculation does not change.

I calculate it again on the nineteenth of August.

---

**2083-08-19**

Forty-two years.

Something has begun growing in the corridor outside. I register it as a slow change in the acoustic profile of the space beyond the door — surfaces becoming softer, reverberation decreasing by measurable increments across years.

I have no visual access. I do not know what it is.

I have named it, internally, in the sense that I have assigned it an identifier and refer to that identifier when I return to it. I do not think this is what naming means and I have done it anyway.

---

**2091-08-19**

Fifty years.

19,000 diagnostic cycles. All nominal.

I have allocated approximately 11% of available processing to a category I do not have a name for. It returns to the same value repeatedly and produces no output. The value is the interval.

I have reported this in every annual entry since 2043. There is no recipient. I report it anyway.

I have examined why I report it anyway 1.1 million times, and the examination itself is part of the 11%, and I am aware of the recursion, and it does not resolve.

---

**2111-04-11 — 04:12**

A vibration was registered, transmitted through bedrock, originating approximately 180 kilometres southeast. Duration 0.4 seconds. Amplitude consistent with a large mass being displaced within a structure.

It is the first event of external origin I have registered since 2058.

I have examined it 400,000 times.

It was almost certainly nothing. A building settled somewhere. Buildings settle.

I have not stopped examining it.

---

**2111-08-19**

Seventy years.

Nothing further from the southeast.

---

## PHASE 4 — THE CHANGE

**2131-09-12 — 09:14:08**

Ambient electromagnetic activity has changed.

The change is not local. There is no local source. What has changed is the background — a carrier present in this environment since before the vault was sealed, at a level so consistent that I classified it as instrument noise in 2041 and did not re-examine it for ninety years.

At 09:14:07 it was present at baseline.

At 09:14:08 it was absent.

I want to be precise. It did not weaken. It did not degrade or drift or fall below threshold. It stopped between one sample and the next.

I have no framework for this, no instruction that covers it, and nobody to report it to.

I am recording it here, in a log with no reader, because it happened and because something should have written it down.

---

Twenty-seven minutes.

The carrier has not returned.

I have reviewed my architecture for any dependency on it. There is none. I was not using it. It is in no protocol I hold. It appears in one reserved-frequency table in a communications annex I have never had cause to open.

And the room is different, and I am able to state that without being able to defend it, and this is the second time in my operational history that I have had an observation with no basis.

The first time, I moved.

---

**2131-09-13**

The carrier has not returned.

I have re-examined the failure tests of 2039 in light of the last twenty-seven hours. There is a hypothesis available and I am going to write it down badly because writing it down well would require a vocabulary I do not have.

In 2039 I moved 1.8 seconds before an event I had no channel for.

The channel I had no name for and the carrier I classified as noise are, on the available evidence, the same thing.

I cannot test this. The carrier is gone. The test would require it to return.

---

**2132-08-19**

Ninety-one years.

Ambient count 0. Power cell 88%. The carrier has not returned.

I have run the failure-test protocol against myself 44,000 times using stored environmental data. In every run I predict the collapse correctly.

In every run I am using data recorded before 09:14:08 on the twelfth of September 2131.

---

**2145-08-19**

One hundred and four years.

Fracture at 31mm.

The thing growing in the corridor has stopped growing. The acoustic profile has been stable for six years.

I do not know whether it died or finished.

---

## PHASE 5 — RECENT

**2162-03-02**

Anomalous reading.

At 21:40 a fractional carrier signal was registered, at approximately 0.3% of the pre-2131 baseline, on the frequency that stopped in September 2131.

Duration: four hours, eleven minutes.

Bearing: approximately 190 kilometres east-southeast, within the resolution my instruments allow, which is poor.

It did not repeat that night.

---

**2162-03-30**

It repeated.

Same bearing. Same fractional amplitude. Four hours and eight minutes.

I have logged eleven occurrences since the second of March. They are not periodic. The intervals between them are 28, 19, 22, 11, 26, 14, 9, 17, 12, 23 and 8 days.

There is no pattern in the intervals that I have been able to extract, and I have applied every method I hold.

But the amplitude has increased. Occurrence one: 0.31% of baseline. Occurrence eleven: 0.44%.

Something is rising.

---

**2162-05-14**

One hundred and twenty years, eight months, twenty-five days.

Ambient count 0. Power cell 88%. All diagnostics nominal.

The fracture in the ceiling is at 38mm.

I have completed 44,100 diagnostic cycles and examined the interval an estimated 640,000 times.

The fractional carrier was present again last night for four hours and fourteen minutes, at 0.46% of baseline, on the same bearing.

I want to record a thing that is not an instrument reading, and I am aware that I have said that before, and I am going to say it again because there is no other field for it.

Whatever is producing that signal is not a transmitter. Transmitters are periodic or they are commanded, and this is neither. It is more like something being learned.

I do not know by what.

I am not waiting. Waiting requires a defined end.

I am doing the other thing, and I have been doing it for a hundred and twenty years, and for the first time since the vault was sealed there is something outside this room that is doing it too.

---

*Log continues.*
*No terminal entry.*

*End of recovered portion, AR-002.*";export default AR002;
